mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months reduces discount rates, increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a flight to quality in equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) reduces consumer purchasing power, compressing future earnings and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during rising unemployment are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) increases consumer purchasing power, boosting future earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during falling unemployment are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.1 indicates weakening supply-side momentum, compressing future earnings and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during contraction are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 104.1 signals strengthening supply-side momentum, boosting future earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during expansion are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in residential construction (HOUST) below 1215.0 indicates cooling housing demand, compressing future earnings and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during cooling are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in residential construction (HOUST) above 1215.0 signals a rebound in housing demand, boosting future earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during expansion are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
